_README: CANONICAL REGISTRY. Every reportable number lives here exactly once. Do not restate a value in prose without citing its key. 'verified' = still matches its artifact; 'reproducible' = re-running the pipeline regenerates that artifact. They are independent — several numbers here are verified but NOT reproducible because the OSM network behind them was overwritten (docs/DATA_LOSS_2026-07-24.md). Run scripts/verify_numbers.py to re-check every entry. REPORTABLE PRECISION: pooled ROC-AUC is reportable to THREE significant figures (0.905). The fourth digit is not stable across platforms — see platform_drift_pooled_auc — and must not be compared, ranked or differenced. Stored values keep full precision so the artifact check stays exact; the RULE governs what may be written in prose, a poster or a slide. ANGULAR PRECISION: circular quantities are NOT AUCs and take a different rule. With n=36 usable steps and a per-step spread of ~56 deg, the standard error of a mean angular difference is ~9 deg, so mean angles are reportable to ONE decimal place and differences smaller than ~19 deg (2 SE) are NOT established. Circular correlations have an approximate SE of 1/sqrt(n) = 0.17 here, so they are reportable to TWO decimals and |r| below ~0.33 is not distinguishable from zero. These are rules of thumb from the observed spread, not exact tests; the fold-level spread (sd ~47-50 deg on 6 folds) is wider still and governs any per-fire claim.
config_hash_note: The per-entry config_hash is re-stamped on every build, so it marks the config a build SAW, not the config a number was PRODUCED under. It moved 0b6eb481177a… -> 51ec446843b6… between the 2026-08-01 build and the 2026-08-02 (PHASE 5 STEP 4) build. That move is PURELY ADDITIVE: `bbox.multi_region_walk_bbox` and `grid.simulation_bbox_extension` were added and NOT ONE existing key changed value (verified key-by-key against config/default.yaml at commit 5fe86db). No Round-2 number is stale as a result. It moved again 05c6feae1dff… -> 8e29a6cc4a99… on 2026-08-03 (PHASE 13), and again PURELY ADDITIVELY: the `fuel:` block (uncovered_land_warn_fraction / uncovered_land_stop_fraction) was added, no existing key changed value, and a rebuild moved 0 of the registered VALUES — only six `sample` labels, which carry the bbox area and therefore inherit the geodesic-area correction described under the mr_* completeness entries.

lofo_rowweighted_pooled_auc.caveat: POOLED and row-weighted — a DIFFERENT quantity from the mean-of-folds 0.890; never present one as the other. ⚠ This is the metric docs/fold_sizes.md §'읽는 법' and two other NUMBERS.json caveats all call the PRIMARY indicator, and until 2026-09-03 it had NO registry key: it lived only in README prose and inside other entries' caveat strings, while the non-primary mean-of-folds was the registered headline. Registering it does NOT promote it — the committed headline is unchanged and which metric leads the narrative is the author's decision (WFG-004, docs/ssot_audit_2026-09-03.md §3). Being row-weighted, it is dominated by the two largest folds: uiseong_andong_2025 supplies 54.47% of the rows and uljin_samcheok_2022 27.42% (docs/fold_sizes.md), so a pooled figure hides the fold that barely beats chance (gangneung_2023 = 0.682, 396 rows, 0.26% of the rows). Trained on the raster that filled the East Sea to −497 m; the corrected re-run of this same quantity is −0.0017 lower and was NOT adopted.

wxdep_drop_days_since_rain_mean_delta.caveat: ⚠ POSITIVE. Removing the TOP-RANKED feature by permutation importance (+0.07726) IMPROVES mean-of-folds by +0.0270 and the far band by +0.0533, while lowering pooled by -0.0142. For three of six fires the feature equals the ERA5 window length exactly (2.88 / 6.88 / 6.88 d) because those windows contain zero wet samples, so it acts as a per-fire constant — a fire fingerprint that raises pooled and damages transfer. Do NOT read this as 'dryness does not matter': it is a statement about this FEATURE as computed, not about dryness.

baseline_hazard_entry_increase.derivation: time_objective.why.enters_hazard - distance_objective.why.enters_hazard (23 - 20), both measured on naive_route
baseline_hazard_entry_increase.caveat: A LIMIT OF THE FIRE-BLIND BASELINE, NOT A COST OF THE PROPOSED SYSTEM. Both figures are naive_route figures, and naive_route never sees the fire under EITHER objective — the hazard only scores it afterwards. Telling a fire-blind router about terrain makes it faster; it cannot make it safer. future_aware_route refuses any node at/above p_cut, so it cannot enter the hazard at all: `both_enter` is 0 at every budget in this sweep. The +3 is therefore direct evidence FOR a hazard-aware routing layer — a reader who attributes it to the proposed system has inverted the finding.
forbidden_phrasings: the proposed system sends 3 more into the fire

ordering_boundary_no_distinct_deadline_t.caveat: ⚠ 단일 임계값이 존재하지 않는다는 측정입니다. 「마감 수 N 이상이면 이긴다」는 N 은 없습니다 — 관계가 단조롭지 않아 마감 6개·7개 구간의 승률은 0 % 인데 3개 구간은 4.1 % 입니다. 셀 단위 상관은 Spearman +0.244 로 약하고, 차이의 크기와는 −0.022 로 사실상 무관합니다. ⚠ 상관이지 인과가 아닙니다. ⚠ 그리고 PHASE 23 §6 의 기제는 이 결과를 다 설명하지 못합니다 — 바닥(마감 2개 → 465셀 전부 0승)은 설명하지만 6·7개 구간의 0 % 는 설명하지 못하고, 마감 수를 고정해도 승률이 계속 움직입니다(영덕 real, 3개 고정, 17.8포인트). 마감 수는 자유 변수가 아니라 (팔 × W) 의 이름표이므로 이 설계로는 개수·퍼짐·W 를 분리할 수 없습니다. 설명이 불완전하다는 것과 무엇이 더 필요한지는 docs/ordering_boundary.md §6.3 에 있으며, 억지 설명을 만들지 않았습니다.

Session 12's reading that 'noise beats Arm E' held for this draw but is NOT a property of the null — Arm E's +0.0059 is itself above the null mean. What survives is the principle the draw was made to establish: adding any two columns moves the fit, so an arm changing feature count needs a matched control.

The point stands and is now quantified: far-band AUC moves more under pure column addition than the 0.0307 platform floor allows for, so far-band arm comparisons need the envelope. armn_noise_a_importance.notes: Session 12. No model default, target, threshold or Arm A artifact was changed. Arm E adds columns beside Arm A's 16; it never replaces one.

An arm that changes the feature count must clear THIS to claim a pooled gain. Null mean is +0.0041, sd 0.0040: adding two columns raises pooled AUC on average even when the columns are meaningless.
column_addition_floor_pooled_p95.notes: Session 13. 60 draws, 6-fire LOGO-CV each, estimator seed fixed at 20250603 so only the noise content varies. No model default, target, threshold or Arm A artifact was changed.

column_addition_floor_far_band_p95.notes: Session 13. 60 draws, 6-fire LOGO-CV each, estimator seed fixed at 20250603 so only the noise content varies. No model default, target, threshold or Arm A artifact was changed.

arme_pooled_percentile_of_null.caveat: THE QUANTIFIED ARM E VERDICT. Inside the null, not beyond it — the pooled gain is what adding two columns does anyway. Supersedes Session 12's single-draw comparison.

Against the distribution that single column was itself at the 99.2nd percentile. upslope_alignment sits +2.79 sd above the noise mean, so the feature is NOT noise — it carries a small, detectable signal. Its fold sd (0.0027) is still ~3.8x its own mean, so it is unstable across folds, and it is far too small to move model-level AUC out of the null.
arme_upslope_alignment_percentile_of_noi.notes: Session 13. 60 draws, 6-fire LOGO-CV each, estimator seed fixed at 20250603 so only the noise content varies. No model default, target, threshold or Arm A artifact was changed.

The Arm E null is clean and therefore stronger than before.

l0_walk_time_to_refuge_failing_median_mi.derivation: Median elderly-gait walking time to the nearest surviving refuge, over the 24 영덕 households with at least one failing scenario. Regenerate: python scripts/vulnerability_drivers.py --distance
l0_walk_time_to_refuge_failing_median_mi.caveat: THE EXPLANATION THE LAYER WAS MISSING. 271.3 minutes EXCEEDS the 240-minute horizon: these households cannot reach any refuge in the evaluated window at 0.7 m/s, whatever the fire does. Safe households sit at 9.5 minutes — a 29x separation. This unifies three earlier nulls: the hazard model cannot matter if you cannot arrive in time, refuge DENSITY cannot matter because only the nearest one counts, and extra network paths cannot matter if all of them are too long. ⚠⚠ SESSION 22 CORRECTION — THE METHOD BEHIND THIS NUMBER WAS WRONG, AND THE VALUE IS LEFT UNCHANGED UNDER THE SESSION 18 FREEZE. scripts/vulnerability_drivers.py::_distances built its graph with nx.Graph(G), but net.graph is a DiGraph whose time_min is SLOPE-ASYMMETRIC — 16,314 of 21,982 reciprocal edge pairs carry different times (median 0.34 min, max 28.4 min), because uphill and downhill walking speeds differ. The undirected collapse keeps one direction arbitrarily, and the virtual-source Dijkstra then measured REFUGE->HOUSEHOLD while the evacuation router walks HOUSEHOLD->REFUGE. Session 22 recomputed it directed and it reproduces the router's failing counts EXACTLY at all six horizons (63/50/36/27/24/8); the reversed direction gives 63/53/36/27/18/8 — wrong at 60 min and at the 240 min DEFAULT. So this figure describes an arbitrarily symmetrised graph traversed backwards, not what the layer does. Session 22's own numbers use the directed computation and are registered separately under arm L0_intervention.
